history.summary: A freehold D23 (Bukit Panjang/Bukit Batok) project (2011) with a very large 1,528 sqft 2BR asking a low $1,374 PSF ($2.1M). The cheap PSF is almost entirely a size artefact — 1,528 sqft is huge for a 2BR — and a $2.1M 2BR in OCR D23 with no MRT in the dossier and a thin 27-txn series is a hard sell. Avoid.
history.rating_rationale: $1,374 PSF looks cheap vs the $1,573 median (-13%) but 1,528 sqft for a 2BR is extreme — the low PSF reflects size, not value, and the $2.1M absolute price is far above the liquid band for a 2-bedder in a non-central district. No MRT listed, OCR D23 location, score 513, weak arena record (179-234). 4.05%/yr on 27 txns is unremarkable. A $2.1M outlay for an oversized 2BR in Bukit Panjang has a narrow buyer pool and weak exit prospects.
red_flags: $2.1M for a 2BR — well above liquid band, thin buyer pool
1,528 sqft 2BR — cheap PSF is a size artefact, not a bargain
no MRT in dossier — weak connectivity for D23
thin 27-txn appreciation series, weak arena record
catalysts: generous space appeals to a narrow family-buyer niche
